steps.title: Thaw and culture cells
steps.instruction: Thaw Invitrogen™ HEK293 Flp‑In™ cells and culture them in Gibco High‑Glucose DMEM supplemented with 10 % FBS at 37 °C in a 5 % CO₂ incubator.

steps.title: Maintain cells for passages
steps.instruction: Maintain the cultured cells for 1–2 passages (approximately 2–4 days) before proceeding.

steps.title: Seed cells in T‑75 flasks
steps.instruction: Seed ~3 × 10⁶ cells (≈10 % confluence) into each of two T‑75 flasks; incubate 48 h so that each flask reaches ~11 × 10⁶ cells (≈35 % confluence). One flask will remain un‑transfected for antibiotic‑selection control.

steps.title: Prepare and add transfection mix
steps.instruction: When the designated flask reaches ~11 × 10⁶ cells, prepare a transfection solution using a ~1:9 plasmid‑to‑pOG44 ratio and add it dropwise.

substeps.instruction: In a tube, combine 0.9 µg OR‑encoding plasmid (with Hygromycin B resistance), 7.9 µg pOG44 vector, and 1.75 mL room‑temperature Opti‑MEM™.
In a second tube, combine 17.5 µL Lipofectamine reagent with 1.75 mL room‑temperature Opti‑MEM™.
Incubate each tube at room temperature for 5 min.
Combine the two mixtures, incubate an additional 20 min at room temperature, and add the mixture dropwise to the transfection‑designated T‑75 flask.
Leave the second T‑75 flask untouched (no transfection).

steps.title: Passage cells 24 h post‑transfection
steps.instruction: Twenty‑four hours after adding the transfection mix, detach cells from each flask and seed ~11 × 10⁶ cells (≈15 % confluence) into new T‑175 flasks.

steps.title: Start Hygromycin B selection
steps.instruction: Add Hygromycin B to each T‑175 flask to a final concentration of 50 µg/mL in the same DMEM + 10 % FBS medium.

steps.title: Refresh selection media every two days
steps.instruction: Replace the media with fresh DMEM + 10 % FBS containing 50 µg/mL Hygromycin B every two days while cells are actively dying (typically 4–6 days).

steps.title: Continue selection until death stops
steps.instruction: When active cell death ceases, continue to change the antibiotic‑containing media twice per week.

steps.title: Expand surviving transfected cells
steps.instruction: Once the un‑transfected flask shows no viable cells and the transfected flask contains at least 10 visible plaques, passage the surviving cells for further experiments or validation.

steps.title: Validate receptor expression
steps.instruction: Label cells with anti‑Flag M1 antibody directly conjugated to AlexaFluor 647 in the presence of calcium, then assess fluorescently labeled receptors by flow cytometry.

steps.title: Analyze images with Fiji
steps.instruction: Process all acquired images using Fiji software, applying identical brightness/contrast settings for consistency.

steps.title: Measure fluorescence by flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Acquire fluorescence data on a Beckman Coulter Cytoflex S (B78557) and analyze using FlowJo™ v10.8.1.
